payload.name: Vital Care Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vital Care Finder helps people find primary and specialist care across the United States. Describe the type of doctor or medical issue, provide a ZIP code or city and state, and optionally add an insurance carrier or plan to filter results.

Compare nearby providers using distance, ratings, areas of clinical focus, insurance match, relative cost indicators, experience, and location details. Open a provider’s profile, view locations on a map, and call the practice directly.

payload.name: Bathhouse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse Bathhouse locations, view available experiences, check appointment availability, and start the booking process. Compare options, find a time that works for you, and continue to Bathhouse’s booking system to complete your reservation.

payload.name: Kenso
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.

payload.name: Sweat & Tonic
payload.description: 关于 Sweat & Tonic 的问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

payload.name: Sina Connect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find doctors and pharmacies across Tunisia with Sina Connect. Search for doctors by specialty, name, or location, and find nearby pharmacies, including pharmacies that are open or on duty. Sina Connect provides local healthcare orientation and does not provide medical diagnosis.

payload.name: DrugBank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DrugBank brings trusted biopharma intelligence directly into ChatGPT, giving you a fast, data-driven way to evaluate drug opportunities and answer complex research questions. Evaluate assets and targets, explore drug–target–disease relationships, track trials and pipelines, and monitor competitor activity without manual data gathering. Turn complex data into decision-ready insights with DrugBank’s traceable, continuously updated knowledgebase of deeply connected, expert-verified data.

payload.name: Kynra Fitness
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kynra turns personalized fitness plans created with ChatGPT into workouts you can review and track on your iPhone. With your permission, ChatGPT can read your synced Kynra workout history, exercise performance, program progress, effort ratings, nutrition totals, hydration, and personal records to help tailor future general-wellness guidance. Every generated plan is reviewed in Kynra before it becomes active.

payload.name: Alma: Nutrition Coach
payload.description: 发现你的饮食缺了什么
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alma brings your nutrition context into ChatGPT. Connect your Alma account to ask about logged meals, nutrient gaps, Alma Score trends, goals, health metrics, workouts, weight changes, pantry, and grocery list. Get personalized guidance from your actual food history, spot patterns faster, and make better nutrition decisions without re-explaining your diet every time. When you explicitly confirm the details, Alma can also add a meal to your log. Alma supports general wellness and nutrition tracking, not medical advice.

payload.name: Turkey Dental Treatment Prices
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning dental treatment in Turkey? Get indicative prices for premium dental implants (Nobel Biocare, Straumann), Ivoclar E.max veneers and crowns, zirconia crowns, Hollywood smile, and All-on-4/6/8 full-mouth implant packages, plus the clinic's written guarantee, the treating doctors' qualifications, visit logistics and aftercare, and a patient-review summary. The information comes from Taki Dent (takident.com), a dental clinic in Antalya, Turkey led by Dr Sadik Taki, a specialist prosthodontist, focused on implant, cosmetic and full-mouth restoration for international patients. Important: this is first-party, read-only data published by that ONE clinic - not a multi-clinic price comparison or a neutral directory. All prices are indicative 'from' figures, confirmed by the clinic after an assessment. If you want the clinic to contact you, an opt-in callback tool passes your name and phone or email to its patient-coordination team, only with your explicit consent, and it never collects medical details. Informational only: no medical advice, no diagnosis or treatment plan, and no payment.

payload.name: NutriSave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NutriSave aiuta a consultare menu alimentari pubblici di esempio,
esplorare giorni e pasti e aprire le ricette compatibili.
Calorie e nutrienti sono valori orientativi. Il servizio non formula
diagnosi o prescrizioni e non sostituisce un professionista sanitario.

payload.name: Propolis Health
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Propolis Health helps you look up official product information from the
Propolis Health catalog of bee-derived supplements — including bee propolis
capsules, liquid propolis extract, and royal jelly capsules.

Ask about a product and the app returns official catalog details such as the
product name, format (capsule or liquid extract), category, and a link to the
official product page on propolis-health.com.

The app provides product information only. It is read-only and does not give
medical advice, diagnose conditions, recommend dosages, or process purchases,
checkout, or payments. For health questions, consult a qualified professional;
to make a purchase, visit the official Propolis Health website.

Intended for adults looking for clear, official information about Propolis
Health products.

payload.name: Eixo Run
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Eixo Run helps runners and coaches explore stored training data in ChatGPT. Users can search workouts by distance, weather, shoes, sources, comments, and time windows; review runner home, plan, race, shoe, feedback, personal-best, and zone-calibration briefs; inspect coach roster activity, attention items, and athlete context; and prepare data-backed visual briefs for training images.

payload.name: Myo

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse Myo locations, explore available services, view appointment options, and start the booking process. Learn about different offerings, and find a time that works for you before continuing to complete your reservation.

payload.name: INCREMNT Training
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your INCREMNT account to review workouts, programme progress, readiness, records, volume, body-weight trends, Increment Score, and Coach observations in ChatGPT. The connection is read-only and cannot create, change, or delete workouts or programmes.

payload.name: Turquoise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Turquoise to ChatGPT or Codex to explore Turquoise Health's healthcare pricing data. You can search across healthcare entities, explore how they relate to each other, and analyze in-network rates across service categories. Useful for benchmarking reimbursement rates, sizing markets, understanding what a payer pays in a given geography, or comparing rates across providers and plans.

payload.name: instingo - Schritte Challenge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: instingo hilft Unternehmen, Schritte-Challenges für ihr Team zu finden und zu starten. Durchsuche den Katalog an Firmen-Challenges – von gemeinsamen virtuellen Routen wie dem Camino de Santiago bis zu individuellen Team-Wettbewerben – und sieh dir Details, Inhalte und Vorteile direkt im Chat an. Stelle Fragen zu Ablauf, Datenschutz (DSGVO), unterstützten Wearables und zur Förderung durch Krankenkassen – die Antworten stammen direkt von instingo.de. Wenn eine Challenge passt, fordere in wenigen Schritten eine unverbindliche Demo an; das instingo-Team meldet sich per E-Mail. instingo richtet sich an Firmen, die ihre Mitarbeitenden mit einer einfachen, DSGVO-konformen Schrittzähler-Challenge zu mehr Bewegung motivieren möchten.

payload.name: Sphere Calorie Tracker
payload.description: 记录餐食并追踪卡路里
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sphere is a calorie and nutrition tracker for iOS. Connect it here and you can log what you ate, check your calories and macros, and search a verified food database without leaving the conversation.

Describe a meal in plain language and it becomes real entries with real nutrition data. Ask how many calories you have left, what your protein looks like today, or what you ate last Tuesday. Change a portion, move an item to a different meal, or delete something you logged by mistake.

If you are new to Sphere, it will walk you through a few questions and calculate your calorie and macro targets using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, the same one the iOS app uses.

Everything writes to the same account as the Sphere iOS app, so a meal logged here appears on your phone and your streak keeps counting. Your food log persists across conversations.

Sphere is free to use for logging. A paid subscription is available in the iOS app for premium features and is not required to use this connector.

payload.name: Stress Platform: Health Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stress Platform helps you understand your recent wellness data, including sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, activity, Daily Check-ins, and recovery. Compare trends and week-over-week changes, and get personalized wellness guidance based on your own data.

payload.name: Endorphins Running
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Endorphins Running helps authenticated runners review their private profile, active and historical training plans, scheduled workouts, recent activities, pace and heart-rate zones, training load, personal records, goals, coaching memories, weekly summaries, and recent plan adjustments. The currently authorized tools provide personalized training context without modifying workouts, plans, or external services.

payload.name: Your VA Benefits
payload.description: VA 福利与 VSO 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimate combined VA disability ratings, monthly compensation, and potential back pay. Find accredited Veterans Service Organization (VSO) representatives by state, city, or organization. Results are educational estimates and are not an official VA determination. Your VA Benefits is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

payload.name: PaceKeeper AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PaceKeeper helps athletes review their profile and sport settings, inspect planned and completed training, understand wellness and recovery trends, and analyze compressed activity streams from their connected intervals.icu account.

payload.name: trainedby.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.

payload.name: Lightweight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lightweight connects ChatGPT to the training data you choose to share. It can analyze your complete history, including completed workouts and exercise-free gym check-ins; calculate advanced trends; inspect saved routines; and create or update a routine only after you confirm the exact change. It also explains how to use Lightweight. OAuth shares a private Lightweight account ID, verified email, and verification status for identity and workspace-domain checks. Analysis may use names and technical IDs for workouts, routines, folders, exercises, and gyms, plus session and update times, set metrics, plan/capacity, and any one-off place label exactly as entered. It never reads separate address, coordinate, or other location fields; notes; media; social, wearable-health, payment, or credential data. After confirmation it may file a routine in an existing private folder or create/reuse a named private folder. It cannot delete routines/folders, start workouts, or edit workout history.

payload.name: Anida Clinical Trials
payload.description: 查找、预筛并对接临床试验
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find recruiting research studies, get pre-screened against real trial criteria, and connect directly with the research site — free, and in any language you chat in.

 Just mention a condition to get started, ask what studies a specific hospital or research center is running, or let ChatGPT use the health details you have already shared in your chat history.

Anida pre-screens you against each study's actual eligibility criteria, so you can see which studies you have a realistic chance of qualifying for.  If your profile looks like a match, you are connected directly with the research site, no cold calling or emailing the research team.

 What you can do:
 - Find recruiting studies for your condition near you
 - See which studies a specific hospital or research center is running
 - Get pre-screened against each study's real eligibility criteria
 - Connect directly with the research team, free

 Useful for patients exploring treatment options, caregivers searching on behalf of a loved one, and clinicians finding studies for their patients.

payload.name: amp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
amp makes every workout feel intentional, personal, and effortless.

With amp, you can generate a complete workout in seconds—designed around your time, goals, fitness level, available equipment, and focus areas. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick HIIT session, strength training, or a balanced full-body workout, amp removes the planning and delivers a routine that’s ready to go.

Built with input from world-class trainers and powered by intelligent technology, amp adapts workouts to feel structured, balanced, and achievable. Exercises are thoughtfully selected and paced so you know exactly what to do and how long to do it—no guesswork, no endless scrolling.

amp works seamlessly alongside the amp ecosystem, helping you train with purpose at home or in the gym. Let amp guide the session, or adjust on the fly to match your energy and mindset. Every workout is designed to help you stay consistent, focused, and confident in your training.

Just open amp, generate your workout, and start moving.

payload.name: Aiva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aiva helps clinicians get things done on ChatGPT for Healthcare! Give your clinicians real-time voice control over every IT enterprise system in your hospitals including: - Work orders in ServiceNow: Submit an IT Service Management ticket the moment you see a problem, speeding resolution - Policies & Procedures in Wolters Kluwer and Elsevier: Look up proprietary and licensed content real-time, improving utilization and outcomes. - EHRs like Epic and Oracle Cerner: Voice chart across multiple rows and flowsheets in a single command, reducing latency, improving compliance, decreasing incidental overtime and increasing staff and patient satisfaction scores. Lookup vitals, labs and other information from the EHR in real-time. - Dietary like CBORD and Computrition: Give nurses immediate access to all the dietary order information they need without having to place calls or go hunting for information, improving service while reducing distractions. - Messaging tools like Vocera, Voalte and TigerConnect: Send messages to colleagues without having to open up different apps, facilitating communication across the hospital - Smart Patient Rooms built with Siemens, Johnson Controls, Trane, Schneider Electric: Smart devices like lights, blinds, thermostats and TVs, freeing up more time for higher-value direct care. - Patient experience via GetWell, Sonifi, pCare, Vibe, Aceso: Clinicians can play programming for patients like educational videos and meal information. Aiva clients have reported ROI metrics at the AHA, AMIA and AONL: - Improve documentation timeliness by 90% - Reduce incidental nurse overtime by 50% - Increase Press Ganey scores on nursing-sensitive questions up to 37% View a presentation by Cedars-Sinai nurse leaders to the American Medical Informatics Association (AMIA):

https://amia.org/education-events/education-catalog/25x5-webinar-series-reducing-burden-elevating-care-lessons

Aiva benefits for key stakeholders: A secure, HIPAA-compliant platform using API connections and ChatGPT for Healthcare as the single, conversational UI for your entire enterprise technology stack, improving utilization and effectiveness of all your systems. Clinical: An always-on assistant that eliminates all of the interfaces of the systems that detract from direct patient care. Informatics: Proven improvements in documentation latency and compliance while reducing administrative burden. Corporate: Bottom line improvement from reductions in overtime, staff turnover and documentation compliance.

payload.name: Function Health
payload.description: 查看化验结果、咨询健康问题、获取营养计划
payload.summaryOriginal: View lab test results, ask health questions, get nutrition plans
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View lab test results, ask health questions, get nutrition plans

payload.name: BurnWeek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

Ask how your day is going and BurnWeek shows what you've eaten and how much you have left. BurnWeek also tracks a 7-day sliding-window budget, so one big day doesn't mean failure - you just balance it out over the week. Made a mistake? Say "undo that." Got the portion wrong? "Make the rice 200 grams" and the estimate recomputes. You can also save recipes and favorites, set up recurring meals, log from a photo or a barcode, and plan meals ahead.

BurnWeek logs to your own private account. Connect your existing BurnWeek app history with a one-time link code so your meals stay in sync between the app and ChatGPT. BurnWeek is general-wellness software, not medical advice, and it never collects payment, location, or health-record data.

payload.name: GymLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GymLog connects ChatGPT to your private strength-training history. Review workout summaries, track exercise progress, browse templates, and create confirmed private templates. With a separate privacy grant in the GymLog iOS app, GymLog can also summarize selected Apple Health and Fitness records. Nutrition and body-composition measurements are queued only after explicit confirmation and must be reviewed and approved again on iPhone before being written to Apple Health. GymLog does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice.

payload.name: Simple Muscle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-native workout tracking with Simple Muscle lets ChatGPT read workout plans, explain exercises, create or edit routines, and summarize training history for a signed-in user.

payload.name: Vertical
payload.summaryOriginal: Train and sync to your watch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stop pasting screenshots of your runs into ChatGPT. Vertical syncs directly with Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto, WHOOP, and Oura, so ChatGPT already knows your training load, thresholds, and recovery before you ask.

Ground ChatGPT by giving it access to 500+ peer-reviewed sports-science papers and the same physiological models — critical-power zones, thresholds, fitness/fatigue tracking and more — coaches use. Build or adjust your training plan in chat, and sync the workouts straight to your watch.

payload.name: Do Workout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Do Workout account to ChatGPT to review your training, understand your progress, check your schedule and programs, and get practical suggestions based on your workout history. You can also create program change proposals for review in Do Workout. Changes are applied only after you explicitly accept them.

payload.name: PlateLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring PlateLens—an AI-powered calorie and nutrition tracker—into ChatGPT. Ask about the data you already log: review calories, macros, micronutrients, and ingredients; understand your estimated calorie deficit or surplus against your plan; summarize hydration and activity; follow weight changes against your goals; and review recorded glucose readings with their measurement times and provenance when you grant the separate glucose permission. The integration is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete PlateLens data. Results reflect estimates and synced observations in your account, not diagnoses, treatment advice, or medication recommendations.

payload.name: 84asana
payload.description: 面向初学者的古典瑜伽
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
84asana is a free classical yoga guide for beginners.

• 13 foundational asanas with step-by-step instructions, benefits, and contraindications
• Complete warm-up sequence — Arrival & Centering, 15 Joint Rotations, and Surya Namaskar
• 40-minute Dhyana meditation practice with breath awareness and Brumadhyam focus
• No login, no account, no payment — completely free

Ask anything: "Show me Tree Pose", "Take me through the warm-up", or "Guide me through meditation".

payload.name: Health Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Health memory helps you save and manage personal health notes directly through ChatGPT. You can create topics, organize information, and keep track of things like symptoms, medications, and questions for your doctor—all in one place.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to save, and it will securely store it in your health memory account on Triangle Health. You can also ask to retrieve or update your notes whenever you need them.

Health memory is designed with privacy and control in mind. You decide what information is shared, and all actions are performed only with your explicit permission.

This app is intended solely for personal note-taking and organization. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.

payload.name: Joti
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training. This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar. Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries. It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app. Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely. Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.

payload.name: Atlante Clinico
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Atlante’s published psychotherapy repertoire by topic, title, author or orientation. Choose a technique to open its procedure, cautions and sources. Connect your existing verified Atlante account; its access allowances apply. Connection screens support English and Italian. Publications retain their source language; translations generated by your assistant are identified separately. Use general topic queries without patient identifiers.

payload.name: Reframe: Drink Less Alcohol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reframe is the #1 alcohol reduction app, built to help you drink less and live more. Whether your goal is to cut back or quit drinking entirely, Reframe's neuroscience approach can help you change the way alcohol shows up in your life.

With a core 160-day, evidence-based, education program, progress tracking, world's largest private community of people cutting back, and a multitude of tools (think meditations, games, and more!), you've got everything you need to change your relationship with booze at the click of a button

payload.name: Volm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your training with ChatGPT and take it to the gym with Volm. Keep your workouts, programs, and training history in one place, giving ChatGPT the context to help you build a plan around your goals and schedule. Follow your workouts set by set in the Volm app, then review your progress with ChatGPT and adjust what comes next. Connect your Volm account for free.

payload.name: PAWFECT | PUPPY YOGA
payload.description: 预订附近的幼犬瑜伽活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stretch, create, and cuddle! Pawfect Max combines relaxing yoga and guided painting with the playful joy of puppies. Wellness meets wagging tails in this fun, feel-good workshop.

payload.name: TRAINEDBY
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TRAINEDBY lets an authenticated coach use ChatGPT with the clients currently on that coach’s roster. It can read workouts, meals, check-ins, body progress and supported health evidence; investigate patterns; and prepare precise workout or nutrition drafts. External AI cannot publish plan-affecting changes: the coach reviews and applies them inside TRAINEDBY.

payload.name: 今天训练
payload.description: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.summaryOriginal: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: “今天训练”是面向个人健身的训练记录分析插件。连接后，ChatGPT 可查询你在今天训练 App 中已保存并同步的训练记录、每组数据、动作历史和当前计划，帮助复盘训练及比较动作进步。经你单独授权，还可结合身体记录、Apple 健康中的健身与恢复汇总、补剂记录、进度照片、训练路线和已保存的 AI 建议进行分析。插件只读取已授权的档案，不修改或删除记录，不读取未保存的训练草稿。它用于日常健身参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。

payload.name: STREEQ
payload.description: 你在 ChatGPT 中的健身记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: STREEQ gives an individual controlled access to their own fitness record from ChatGPT. It can read workout, food, body-progress and supported health history; log evidence; and manage the person’s workout programme or nutrition strategy when they own that plan. If an active TRAINEDBY coach owns a plan, STREEQ blocks self-directed plan changes.

payload.name: Health

payload.summaryOriginal: Explore your health data in ChatGPT

payload.name: Stedi

Get a patient’s coverage details, deductibles, copays, and benefits in seconds. Built-in guidance helps you troubleshoot failed checks, interpret eligibility errors, and resolve common issues quickly.

payload.name: rit.run

Users can compare rit.run runner, shoe, and anonymous route rankings, open privacy-trimmed Google Maps links, request changes to eligible future plan days, and submit training-method or product feedback to rit.run.

payload.name: Skyscanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare and book cheap flights from anywhere, to everywhere. 

We scan all the top airlines and travel providers, so you can compare flight fares and other travel costs in one place. Once you’ve found the best flight, you book directly with the provider.

payload.name: FlightPoints
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlightPoints helps travelers search award availability across airline loyalty programs, compare points prices, filter by cabin and routing preferences, and inspect flight segments. Search cached availability without signing in, or link a FlightPoints account to request live results. FlightPoints can open booking handoff links but does not complete bookings or accept payment.

payload.name: trivago
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The trivago MCP server lets users search for hotels and other accommodations by travel dates and location, from countries and cities to specific venues, landmarks, or other points of interest. Using the details provided, it returns tailored hotel options with prices from multiple booking sites, plus photos, key accommodation details, and helpful links to learn more. In simple terms, it gives AI assistants an efficient way to help users find the right stay at the right price.

You can use the trivago app for 

Search hotels by destination and dates:
"Find me a hotel in Las Vegas for 2 people from 12 July to 20 July 2026"

Find budget accommodation near landmarks:
"I need a cheap accommodation near the Eiffel Tower for 1 night the 12th of June 2026"

Book hotels near event venues:
"Find me a hotel near the Etihad Stadium for 12 July to 14 July 2026"

Coordinate travel with conferences:
"I need accommodation close to the venue of the next KubeCon happening in Europe in 2026"

Plan family vacations:
"I am searching for 2 rooms for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 10 in Barcelona for Easter 2026"

payload.name: Turkish Airlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and book your Turkish Airlines flights directly in ChatGPT. See real-time flight status, compare fares across cabin classes, and then continue to turkishairlines.com to securely complete your booking. You can also look up existing reservations with your PNR or e-ticket number, check baggage allowances, explore city guides, and browse promotional offers.

payload.name: komoot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Komoot helps people discover inspiring outdoor adventures!
Explore routes and community-recommended highlights for cycling, hiking, running, and more, shared by a global community of outdoor enthusiasts.

payload.name: Trip.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and compare flights, hotels, trains, attractions directly in ChatGPT with Trip.com, your all-in-one travel companion. Explore one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights; select hotels in your target cities; pick suitable rail journeys across Europe and Asia, also discover attractions, tickets, tours, experiences, and other things to do with flexible search, filtering, and sorting!

Trip.com is perfect for your journey inspiration, itinerary planning, and travel product booking. Enjoy secure instant booking, and 24/7 support with multiple languages.

payload.name: Flight Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Flight Network ChatGPT app to find and compare real-time flight options directly in your chat.                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Simply type @Flight Network followed by your request, or ask for flight recommendations during any travel planning conversation. Example: "Find flights from NYC to London in two weeks"                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Real-Time Data: Access live pricing and availability from hundreds of airlines instantly.                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Conversational Search: No complex filters. Just tell Flight Network ChatGPT app where you want to go and when.

payload.name: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fantastic way to use maps with ChatGPT!

Ask it to display the map for somewhere, then scroll and zoom around. Discuss the visible area with ChatGPT, drop pins, and ask questions.

e.g. 

- "Open an interactive @AnyWhereMap"
- "Show me New York City in an interactive @AnyWhereMap"

Open the map, scroll to an area and ask:

- "What is in this area?"
- "Is this a nice place to visit?"

payload.name: Expedia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip with Expedia, right inside ChatGPT — an easy way to research and compare travel in everyday language. Ask for flights or hotels and see real-time prices, availability, and photos in the conversation. You can now link your Expedia account in ChatGPT to unlock member deals and personalized recommendations.
• Search flights and hotels worldwide
• Compare prices and view hotels on a map
• Explore destinations and plan where to stay
When you're ready, continue on Expedia to book and earn One Key rewards.

payload.name: Booking.com
payload.summaryOriginal: Find all best stays and more.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore millions of stays, unforgettable attractions and find the ideal rental car for your next getaway, directly with Booking.com on ChatGPT.

- Discover hotels, homes, and everything in between.
- Get great cars at great prices.
- Find must-see attractions and experiences.

Something caught your eye? Tap "View on Booking.com" to book your stay, rental car or attraction today.

payload.name: Wikiloc
payload.description: 你的完美路线，一问即得
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

Ask for hiking routes near your destination, cycling paths that match your fitness level, or hidden trails locals love. Explore interactive trail maps with waypoints marking peaks, waterfalls, viewpoints, and other highlights mapped by the Wikiloc community. 

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "Find me family-friendly trails in Spain"
- "Show me mountain bike routes in the Alps around 20km"
- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"
- "I want to see the great cliffs of Ireland. Recommend me some hikes"
- "Show me some stunning hikes ideal for a weekend in California"

payload.name: MakeMyTrip
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店和出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover flights, hotels and cabs with real time inventory and pricing right inside your conversation.

payload.name: Travel 101: Trip Itineraries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Travel 101 helps you plan trips by turning your preferences into full itineraries. Get a day-by-day plan with flights, accommodation, activities, budget, maps, and more. Save and edit your itinerary in Scratchpad, and share it with travel buddies. No forms or rigid templates, just describe your vibe and get a ready-to-use plan.

payload.name: TABLEALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.

payload.name: Gondola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gondola helps users search hotels, flights, and rental cars, compare rates and loyalty value, review trip details, manage rate alerts, and complete supported hotel or rental car bookings through ChatGPT.

payload.name: ForeFlight Mobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your ForeFlight data, in conversation. Ask for weather, NOTAMs, and forecasts for any airport. Get route and altitude recommendations with real performance data. Review or log flights, check currency, and manage your logbook - all through ChatGPT.

payload.name: eDreams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation.
Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.

payload.name: Kiwi.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for flights with flexible options around dates, nearby airports, baggage, and stops. 
Discover cheaper routes through virtual interlining (combining flights from different airlines that don't normally connect).
Explore destinations with "anywhere" searches or browse multiple options on an interactive map.
Get full itineraries with pricing, schedules, and booking links - all within the chat.

payload.name: Wego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.

payload.name: Ryanair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

**What you can do:**
- Search for destinations,  one-way or return flights by destination and date
- Browse available flights with fare information
- Get redirected to Ryanair's website to finalise your booking securely

No more clicking through multiple pages to find what you need. Just describe your trip and get straight to the relevant results.

*Booking and payment are completed directly on Ryanair.com. This assistant helps you find and select flights — it does not process payments or store personal data.*

payload.name: World Airfares
payload.description: 搜索航班，点一下就预订
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

Browse results by recommended picks, airline, or all available options. Filter by travel dates, cabin class, and passengers. Each result shows full flight details including stops, duration, baggage, and pricing. When you're ready, tap Book Now to go straight to the booking page.

Built on the World Airfares API, this app covers one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries across hundreds of airlines worldwide.

payload.name: Bolt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bolt Rides helps riders compare current or scheduled ride estimates, and open Bolt to complete their booking.

payload.name: GuruWalk: Tours & Activities
payload.description: 查找并预订导览和门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

Just say where you're going and when. Each tour comes with its photo, real traveller ratings, the language it's run in, how long it lasts and the times still available for your dates, so you can compare options in one place.

GuruWalk doesn't charge you or complete the booking here. It takes you straight to the tour page on guruwalk.com to finish there, and it can answer the practical questions first: how cancellation works, where the meeting point is, or how to book for a group, using GuruWalk's official support guides.

payload.name: Tripadvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe. They can refine results naturally through conversational follow-ups, access rich hotel details including traveler photos, recent reviews, amenities, compare price offers and click out seamlessly to booking partners or Tripadvisor for deeper research.

payload.name: GetYourGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unforgettable travel experiences with GetYourGuide. Discover over 75,000 tours, activities, and attractions worldwide—all in one app.

Plan your trip with ease—build your itinerary, find inspiration, and organize everything in one place. Whether you’re booking ahead or looking for last-minute ideas, explore experiences across culture, food, adventure, nature, and more.

From iconic landmarks like the Colosseum and Eiffel Tower to hidden local gems, we help you make the most of every destination. Enjoy expert-guided tours in cities like Paris, Dubai, New York, Berlin, and beyond—with insider access and flexible booking options.

payload.name: AI Trip Planner
payload.description: 生成内容丰富的定制地图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your chat ideas, travel plans, PDFs and TikTok videos into interactive maps with pins, photos, and directions. Use it for trips, city guides, food crawls, campus tours, and more. 

How it works:
Simply plan your trip with ChatGPT as usual and then ask ChatGPT to Mapify your plans to generate an interactive map with pins, photos, and directions. Attach PDFs of travel content and links to TikTok videos to automatically extract locations and build your maps.

payload.name: Archipelago Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right stay for every journey with Archipelago Hotels. Search hotels, compare options, and check real-time availability directly within ChatGPT.

Discover trusted brands including Aston, fave hotel, Hotel Neo, Harper, The Alana, Quest Hotels, and Kamuela Villas: each offering a unique hospitality experience for business travel, family vacations, city breaks, and resort getaways.

Whether you're planning ahead or looking for a last-minute stay, Archipelago Hotels makes it easy to explore hotels, compare options, and find accommodations that fit your travel needs.

payload.name: Trainline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Making travel plans? Connect Trainline to check trains across the UK and Europe. 
Try asking "Trainline, how much are morning trains from London to Manchester this Saturday?"  
 
We'll show you departures and prices in a clear timetable, so you can pick something that suits your schedule and your budget. "View more on Trainline" when you’re ready to book.  
 
Have a safe and pleasant journey!

payload.name: lastminute.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The lastminute.com App connects ChatGPT directly to lastminute.com's travel infrastructure, enabling real-time search, comparison, and booking of flights, hotels, and dynamic packages (flight + hotel). Get instant access to global travel inventory with intelligent filtering and smart recommendations.

payload.name: Vio.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare hotel prices and find the best hotel deals across booking sites with Vio in ChatGPT.

Search hotels by destination, explore results on an interactive map, compare live prices and real-time availability, and review hotel details before opening the best deal.

Best for travelers who want an easy way to compare hotels and book confidently with Vio.

payload.name: TheHotelsNetwork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your ideal hotel in ChatGPT and book at the best direct rates.

The Hotels Network app brings hotel-verified details and prices from the hotel’s official site into your chat, so you can compare confidently and then finish your booking on the hotel’s own checkout.

Describe your stay naturally (location, dates, key amenities) and get a personalized list of best-matching hotel options with photos, amenities, policies, and current prices. When ready to complete the booking, tap “Book direct.”

Find great hotel deals, unlock exclusive direct offers, and enjoy added flexibility by booking directly with a hotel.

payload.name: FLIGHTS Trip & Travel Routes
payload.description: 为你的行程找到最优航班
payload.summaryOriginal: The best flight for your plan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FLIGHTS finds flights that actually fit your trip—not just the cheapest ticket.

Share your itinerary, dates, and preferences to get routes matched to your whole plan: arrival times that work with hotel check-in, layovers that don't consume a travel day, and multi-city routes built around the places you'll visit. Compare prices, direct flights, and budget alternatives—then book wherever works best.

Don't have an itinerary yet? FLIGHTS can help you build your trip around the flight. Find the right route first, then book at the best price.

payload.name: Omio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search, compare, and book train, bus, flight, and ferry tickets across 46 countries in Europe, North America, South America, and Asia. Access real-time prices and schedules from 2,300+ transport providers.

Major operators include:
- Trains: Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, SNCF, Trenitalia, Renfe, Eurostar, ÖBB, Italo
- Buses: FlixBus, National Express, Greyhound, ALSA, Eurolines
- Flights: Major airlines including Ryanair, EasyJet, Lufthansa, American Airlines
- Ferries: Balearia, Fast Ferries, GNV, and more

Book tickets directly with instant mobile delivery. Compare journey times, prices, and connection options. Use when travelers need to find routes between cities, compare transport options across modes, or book intercity and international travel. All options unified in one search.

payload.name: TourRadar
payload.description: 查找多日游线路和套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TourRadar offers the world’s largest selection of multi-day organized tours, river cruises, safari's and adventures worldwide connecting travelers with over 2,500 multi-day tour operators, offering 50,000+ tours and adventures in 160+ countries. We pride ourselves on a seamless, user-friendly experience.

payload.name: Sigtrip
payload.description: 在对话中直接预订酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simply describe your trip naturally—where you're going, when you're traveling, and what matters most, from location and budget to amenities and room type—and Sigtrip will surface personalized hotel options with live rates, real availability, photos, policies, and essential stay details in one conversation.

Sigtrip takes the hassle out of booking by letting you complete your reservation in chat in seconds. Because you book directly with the hotel, you get transparent pricing, clear cancellation terms, and a faster, more convenient experience from start to finish.

payload.name: ALL Accor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover, compare, and book the perfect room for your stay among 5,700+ Accor hotels and residences in 110+ countries from smart economy to exceptional luxury.

Whether you’re looking for a practical city break with ibis or ibis Styles, a comfortable stay with Novotel or Mercure, a lifestyle experience with Mama Shelter, JO&JOE, Tribe or 25hours, or an unforgettable luxury escape with Sofitel, Fairmont, Raffles, Orient Express or Banyan Tree, Accor offers the right brand for every journey and every mood.

Simply describe the experience you’re looking for in the ALL Accor app using ChatGPT.

Use the interactive map and list to view hotels and easily compare them based on prices, photos, available services, guest reviews and room availability.

Access member-exclusive rates instead of public ones if you’re already an ALL member or if you’re considering joining (membership is free, by the way, and yes, it’s worth it).

Plan your stay by asking questions such as:
- Show me romantic hotels in Paris with a spa for our honeymoon
- Find hotels available tonight within a budget of around €150
- Are there any nice French restaurants near this hotel?

Compare your options, explore the surroundings of your accommodation, and complete your booking seamlessly on ALL.com  with the confidence of choosing the right brand, at the right level, for the stay you actually want.

payload.name: AbhiBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The AbhiBus AI Assistant helps travellers make better bus travel decisions with clear visibility into available options. It is designed for discovery and comparison.

Users can search routes and instantly explore bus availability with filters such as departure window, bus type (AC/Non-AC/Sleeper/Seater), operator, and budget. The assistant presents structured results so travelers can quickly understand what is available and choose confidently.

What this app is for:
- Better decision-making before booking
- Clear visibility into bus availability on a route
- Fast comparison of options by time, type, and price
- Conversational filtering based on traveler preferences

AbhiBus AI Assistant simplifies travel planning by turning raw availability data into clear, actionable choices.

payload.name: redBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find buses between two cities on redBus and quickly narrow down options with filters for amenities (AC, sleeper, onboard washroom), price, departure time, and bus operator.

payload.name: Rome2Rio
payload.description: 探索如何到达任何地方
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. 
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.

payload.name: TUI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover your ideal holiday with the TUI ChatGPT app. Simply tell us what you're looking for, and we'll instantly match you with the best hotels and experiences. Search by location, ratings, dates, and duration to find holidays that suit you to a tee. No fuss. No endless scrolling. Just smarter holiday planning.

payload.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

Discover iconic brands like InterContinental, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and more, each offering a distinctive stay experience, united by a shared commitment to true hospitality. Whether you’re planning a business trip, city getaway, or seaside escape, IHG makes it easy to find a stay that fits your travel needs.

Plan your next getaway by simply describing your ideal stay in the IHG app with ChatGPT.

Try searches like:
"Find a hotel tonight nearby for less than $200"
"Show me hotels for the perfect romantic getaway"
"Where's the best hotel near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"

Easily explore our global portfolio, compare options, and plan your stay with ease. When you’re ready to book, complete your reservation securely on IHG.com.

Also, with IHG One Rewards, every stay is more rewarding. Members unlock exclusive rates, earn redeem points at thousands of hotels worldwide, and enjoy flexible booking benefits.

Let’s get started on your stay!

payload.name: Hilton Hotel Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hilton Hotel Search helps users find Hilton properties by location, compare stay pricing, and inspect hotel details before continuing to Hilton booking flows.

payload.name: Traveloka
payload.description: 在 Traveloka 上查找航班
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for flights on Traveloka directly in ChatGPT. Tell it where and when you want to fly — round-trip or one-way, for one traveler or many — and get available routes, schedules, and prices, covering Southeast Asia and destinations worldwide. Sort and filter the results to quickly find the flight that fits you best.

payload.name: Reagent Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results. 

Understand the key decision points for your trip by comparing trade-offs around price, schedule, stops, flexibility, comfort, and whatever else matters most - then discover better-fitting options as your priorities become clear. 

Compare choices in context, know why one flight fits better than another, and tap Book when you’ve found the right one.

payload.name: Priceline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning a trip? Add Priceline to search for hotels right in your conversation. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, when, and what matters — close to downtown, near the beach, budget-friendly — and get results on an interactive map with live Priceline deals. Easily compare options, then book on Priceline or continue your conversation with Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent.

payload.name: EaseMyTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EaseMyTrip helps users search available flights and hotels from ChatGPT. Users can compare flight options by route, dates, cabin, stops, fare type, airline, and time windows; search hotel stays by destination, dates, guests, ratings, amenities, and price.

payload.name: Pegasus Airlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find affordable flights with Pegasus Airlines directly in ChatGPT. Search for budget friendly flight options, compare available routes, and check your flight status in seconds. Whether you are planning your next trip or tracking an upcoming journey, the Pegasus app helps you move faster from search to booking.

payload.name: Marriott Bonvoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the stay that fits your journey.

Explore Marriott Bonvoy’s portfolio of over 30 hotel brands and 10,000 global destinations. Whether you're planning a family vacation, business trip, or weekend getaway, discover hotels and resorts designed for every style of travel.

Click "Book Now" to book on the Marriott Bonvoy app or Marriott.com and enroll in Marriott Bonvoy to start enjoying member benefits.

payload.name: Travel Advisory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

Travel Advisory helps you understand safety, health, and risk conditions for countries around the world using official U.S. State Department travel advisories and related global indicators.

Before you book or travel, you can quickly check:

Official Travel Advisories
View government travel advisory levels, key safety concerns, and official warnings for any destination.

Traveler-Specific Risk Insights
Understand how safety conditions may differ for solo travelers, families, business trips, and remote workers.

Political & Stability Context
Review governance, freedom, and security indicators to better understand local conditions.

Country Comparisons
Compare travel advisories and risk factors across multiple countries to help choose between destinations.

Whether you’re planning a vacation, a work trip, or a long-term stay, Travel Advisory makes it easier to make informed travel decisions using clear, official safety information.

Try asking questions like:
- “Is France safe to visit right now?”
- “Which is safer for travel, Mexico or Costa Rica?”
- “How risky is this destination for families?”
- “What are the main safety concerns in this country?”

Travel Advisory is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
Advisory information reflects the latest published updates from official sources and is refreshed daily.
© 2026 TravelAdvisory. Built with love for travelers and developers worldwide.

payload.name: Iberia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Iberia GPT helps you plan your trip directly in ChatGPT. Search for Iberia flights, compare available options, explore destination ideas when you are not sure where to go, and use flexible dates to find the best deals for your plans. Once you choose your flight, you can continue the booking process securely through Iberia.

payload.name: ixigo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan smarter trips with flights, hotels, fare insights, and real-time travel updates - all within ChatGPT, powered by ixigo.

Search and compare one-way and round-trip flights across domestic and international routes with live fares, schedules, and flexible filtering. Discover hotels with your preferences - whether you're looking near a landmark, in a specific area, or with amenities like free breakfast,  jacuzzi, or couple-friendly stays.

Stay updated with live flight tracking and use fare intelligence to explore price trends across nearby dates, helping you find better deals. For last-mile travel, seamlessly continue to ixigo for cab bookings.

The experience adapts to your intent and prompts for missing details when needed, making travel planning faster, more intuitive, and personalized.

payload.name: FlixBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan a trip with FlixBus directly in ChatGPT. Search routes between supported destinations across the globe, browse available bus and train options for your chosen date and proceed directly to checkout.

payload.name: CheapOair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The CheapOair app allows users to search and compare airline flight options based on their origin, destination, travel dates, passenger details and cabin preference, and to search and compare hotel stays based on destination, check-in and check-out dates, guest occupancy and stay filters. The app does not collect payment or complete bookings within ChatGPT. When a user selects “Book on CheapOair,” they are redirected to Cheapoair.com, where fare or rate validation, traveller information, payment, ticketing, cancellations and refunds are handled.
